content: In the experiments that we conducted with TwitterNLP for named-entity recognition, we worked with the default values of the model. Furthermore, we selected the 3-class Stanford NER model, which uses the classes “person,” “organization,” and “location” because it resulted in higher accuracy compared to the 7-class model. For CogComp-NLP NER we used Ontonotes 5.0 NER model BIBREF27. For spaCy NER we used the `en_core_web_lg' model.
